MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON JAN-13-2010 IN 206, DEFENDANT ALEX RODRIGUEZ' MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL AND RELATED DATES AND DEADLINES IS HEARD. AT THE HEARING, MR. HAMERSLOUGH, COUNSEL FOR CROSS- DEFENDANTS MARK KAY MCLANAHAN AND SARAH GARLIK, STIPULATED ON BEHALF OF HIS CLIENTS THAT THEY WOULD NOT OBJECT TO EVIDENCE AT TRIAL THAT DEFENDANT AND CROSS-COMPLAINANT SENT A NOTICE OF CANCELLATION IN MARCH 2009. HE FURTHER STIPULATED THAT CROSS-DEFENDANTS WOULD NOT OBJECT IF CROSS-COMPLAINANT MOVED TO CONFORM HIS PLEADINGS TO CONFORM TO THAT EVIDENCE. MR. HAMERSLOUGH THEN REPORTED TO THE COURT THAT HE HAD CONSULTED BY TELEPHONE WITH MR. JUNGREIS, COUNSEL FOR CROSS-DEFENDANT DANIEL DURAN, AND THAT MR. JUNGREIS HAD AGREED TO THE SAME STIPULATION ON BEHALF OF HIS CLIENT. MR. EPSTEIN, COUNSEL FOR CROSS-COMPLAINANT ALEX RODRIGUEZ, ACCEPTED THE STIPULATION. IN RELIANCE ON THAT STIPULATION, THE COURT DENIED THE MOTION TO CONTINUE. WRITTEN ORDER PENDING. JUDGE: JAMES J. MCBRIDE; CLERK: R. VELUZ; MATTER NOT REPORTED. (206)
